selection_rule: Phase 24 executes only inside the admitted court container. This committed manifest records the one admitted venue -- the container marker, the opt-in environment flag, and the image identity and platform the venue records in the environment -- and `forensics/tools/phase24_guard.py` fails closed unless every one of them is present and matches. Nothing about the downstream-1000 atlas is built, run or probed outside this venue (docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md section 1).
metadata_only_rule: `metadata_only` names the Phase-24 generators that read committed atlases and write a ledger -- they execute nothing, no compiler, no probe, no downstream build -- so the guard admits them on any host exactly as the other strata's obligation generators run host-side in CI's static job. Every execution entry point (the runner `phase24_courts.py`, and every later subphase tool that configures, builds, links or runs a downstream project) is deliberately absent from this list, so a host invocation of one is refused. The four **pure derivations** that `evidence_determinism.py` regenerates and compares are admitted beside `phase24_obligations.py`, because that gate also runs host-side in CI's static job and they must not refuse there: `downstream_freeze.py`, `downstream_holdout.py`, `downstream_failures.py` and `downstream_reconciliation.py` each read only committed Phase-24 artefacts and write a derived plane -- they fetch nothing, compile nothing, link nothing and run no downstream program, so a host invocation of one executes no command and produces no runtime evidence. Any tool that fetches, compiles, links or runs a downstream program (the build/link, runtime, high-value, hostility, candidate-freeze and P1000-run tools) stays deliberately absent and is refused on the host.
non_claims: the admitted venue is a container identity, not a security boundary: it records where Phase 24 runs, not what it may claim
the manifest is authored evidence, not proof the container is unmodified: it binds the venue a receipt names, and the image digest is the stronger binding a later subphase may add
admitting a metadata-only generator on the host is not admitting host execution: that generator runs no command and produces no runtime evidence
